execution_contract.supervisor_policy: Root binds independently reviewed executable supervisor before admission; no legacy launcher supplied or authorized by this packet.
execution_contract.identity: Prelaunch exact executable read lease/hash held through explicit owned-child exit; same-owned-handle image proof plus CIM PID/parent/start/full argv. No image-query retry on timeout.
execution_contract.lifecycle: Independent 480-second owned-handle child deadline. Bounded stop/exit waits; Dispose is never exit evidence. Unconfirmed exit retains executable and owner leases in exceptional safety hold for root attention.
execution_contract.stage: Root alone prepares exact clean commit/tree and verifies required base closure. Snapshot actual current owner/stage metadata; do not restore a stale stage pin. No stage preparation authorized by CPU packet check.
execution_contract.admission: One fresh output/home, exact job/manifest/source/profile/supervisor hashes and root grant. Existing resource minima and caps remain mandatory; source improvement is not a headroom forecast.
